summary: Vissel Kobe 2026/27 home shirt: Rakuten front, Bishop (right collarbone) and Debs (left collarbone), Kawasaki Heavy Industries on the back, Suzette Holdings below the back number, Noevir on the left sleeve, Digiara Holdings on the front of the shorts, and Asics Japan as kit supplier. All placements confirmed on the club's uniform-partners page (2026/27).
